messages:
emily: Quick sync — trying to lock the benchmark narrative for the launch week. Goal: make latency vs cost tradeoffs tangible for three buyer slices (consumer chat, search/qa, reranking). Thoughts on which visuals land best + how we route inbound?
kevin: I like a 2-panel approach: (1) cost vs latency scatter (points = model+workload) with iso-cost lines, (2) stacked bar for cost composition (tokens + compute + infra). Show both p50 and p95 latency.
tara: For design: keep it to 3 visuals max. Scatter + single annotated example trace. Avoid heavy log scales unless we annotate clearly. Use our brand palette, and annotate the typical SLAs (200ms, 500ms, 2s). :art:
jon: For inbound routing: landing page should have 2 forms: quick-start (email + use-case) -> growth/self-serve flow, and enterprise intake (company, org size, SLA needs) -> sales. We can code simple routing rules in GA + webhook. Example rule: `if estimated_monthly_tokens > 50M -> tag:enterprise`
alex: Sales note — if we claim <200ms for consumer chat, we need a clear case study or an asterisk: how it changes with burst and history length. Also want a short enterprise CTA copy we can use in outreach.
kevin: Pasted tiny sample dataset for visuals (feel free to use as placeholder):
```
model,workload,latency_p50_ms,latency_p95_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens_usd
redwood-small,consumer-chat,120,280,0.45
redwood-medium,search,340,760,0.32
redwood-quant,rerank,210,480,0.12
```
kevin: Also recommend a small inset showing autoscaling behavior: cost per token vs QPS, to reassure enterprise folks about predictable economics.
emily: Webinar hook idea: "Latency that scales, economics that don't surprise" — 20min demo + 10min Q&A. Run with ops and product. Who can present the bench methodology and who owns the demo? :timer_clock:
bench-bot: New benchmark run uploaded by @kevin — s3://redwood-bench/runs/2025-06-14/microbench-v2.csv :link:
tara: I can do the visuals once kevin confirms final CSV. Need final copy and annotations by EOD Wednesday to hit design sprint.
jon: I'll own inbound routing and the GA/webhook implementation. Will drop a rules doc by EOD Tuesday.
emily: Awesome. Action items: 1) kevin = confirm CSV + p95 vs p50 splits, 2) tara = visuals + annotated SLAs, 3) jon = routing rules + webhook, 4) alex = enterprise CTA + asterisks for claims. We'll reconvene Friday 10am to review assets. Thanks all :sparkles:
